_comment: World configuration for Odyssey-7 - Ship layout, locations, and core game settings

victory_conditions.name: Survive 7 Days
victory_conditions.description: Survive until rescue arrives on day 7

cryo_bay.name: Cryo Bay
cryo_bay.description: Rows of cryo-pods line the walls, most empty. Emergency lights cast eerie blue shadows. The pod you woke from still hisses with residual coolant.

command_bridge.name: Command Bridge
command_bridge.description: The nerve center of Odyssey-7. Control stations glow with warning indicators. Viewport shows nothing but empty space and distant stars.

engineering.name: Engineering Bay
engineering.description: Massive reactor core dominates the space. Control panels flicker. The smell of ozone and burnt circuitry fills the air.

reactor_room.name: Reactor Room
reactor_room.description: The ship's nuclear heart beats with unstable energy. Temperature is elevated. Radiation warnings flash on every panel.

med_bay.name: Medical Bay
med_bay.description: Sterile white walls. Medical scanner humming. Supply cabinets partially depleted. An examination table sits empty.

crew_quarters.name: Crew Quarters
crew_quarters.description: Personal bunks and lockers. Photos and personal effects scattered. Signs of hasty abandonment.

mess_hall.name: Mess Hall
mess_hall.description: Tables and chairs in disarray. Food synthesizer offline. Emergency rations visible in storage.

cargo_bay.name: Cargo Bay
cargo_bay.description: Vast space filled with shipping containers and equipment. External airlock doors sealed. Some containers damaged.

observation_deck.name: Observation Deck
observation_deck.description: Panoramic viewport showing the void of space. Comfortable seating area. Peaceful, yet isolating.
